name: copilot-gateway
description: Independent local Copilot gateway for Codex Responses, OpenAI clients, and Claude Desktop.

commands.title: Copilot Gateway: Export Codex Model Catalog
Copilot Gateway: Authorize Native Codex Responses
Copilot Gateway: Configure Claude Desktop Gateway
Copilot Gateway: Restore Claude Desktop Configuration

enumDescriptions: Uses the public VS Code model adapter. Reasoning effort is locked to the default.
Forwards natively to Copilot. Enables reasoning levels and native compaction; requires GitHub authorization.
copilotGateway.responsesBackend.description: Responses transport: public VS Code model adapter, or opt-in native Copilot forwarding for reasoning history and compaction. Native endpoint support depends on your Copilot model/account.

copilotGateway.githubAuthProvider.description: Account used for Direct mode sign-in. For GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency, also set github-enterprise.uri (for example https://yourorg.ghe.com).

copilotGateway.port.description: Port number for the proxy server

copilotGateway.autoStart.description: Automatically start the server when VS Code launches

copilotGateway.defaultModel.description: Default model to use when not specified in request (leave empty to use first available)

copilotGateway.codexCatalogPath.description: Optional absolute JSON path to update automatically for Codex model_catalog_json. A catalog is always maintained in this extension's global storage; exported catalogs are also kept updated.

copilotGateway.logRequestsToUI.description: Log all requests and responses to the status panel UI

copilotGateway.rawLogging.description: Log raw request/response content to the output channel (verbose)

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
